Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Always FIXT.1.1. First field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of the message body. Second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Message type. Third field in the message.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Comp ID of the party sending the message.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Comp ID of the party the message is sent to. Limited to a maximum of 11 characters.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Indicates a possible resend of an application message.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Original sending time for resent messages.

Field.Name: ApplVerID
Field.Description: Application version ID. Indicates the version of FIX application messages.

Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Always FIXT.1.1. First field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of the message body. Second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Message type. Third field in the message.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Comp ID of the party sending the message.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Comp ID of the party the message is sent to. Limited to a maximum of 11 characters.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Indicates a possible resend of an application message.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Original sending time for resent messages.

Field.Name: ApplVerID
Field.Description: Application version ID. Indicates the version of FIX application messages.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three byte, simple checksum. Always the last field in the message.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Method of encryption. 0 = None/other (encryption is not supported at the session level).

Field.Name: NextExpectedMsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Next expected message sequence number to be received.

Field.Name: EncryptedPasswordMethod
Field.Description: Encryption method used to encrypt the password fields.

Field.Name: EncryptedNewPassword
Field.Description: Encrypted new password when changing the password.

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: Default application version ID. Specifies the service pack release (FIX 5.0 SP2).

Field.Name: TestMessageIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether the session is a test session.

Field.Name: SessionStatus
Field.Description: Status of the FIX session at logout.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Test request identifier returned in the resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: First message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Last message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by the Exchange Participant.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Instrument identifier. Security ID with leading zeroes will not be accepted.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Source of the SecurityID. Must be 8 (Exchange Symbol).

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange code. Must be XHKG (FIX exchange code for HKEX).

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type. Valid values: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: PositionEffect
Field.Description: Indicates whether the order opens or closes a position.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the firm for this order.

Field.Name: MaxPriceLevels
Field.Description: Maximum number of price levels the order may sweep.

Field.Name: LotType
Field.Description: Lot type of the order (board lot, odd lot, special lot).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the replacement order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order being replaced.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Must match the original order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Order quantity of the replacement order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the cancel request.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the targeted order to cancel.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Order quantity of the order being canceled.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the cancel request was initiated.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the mass cancel request.

Field.Name: MassCancelRequestType
Field.Description: Specifies the scope of the mass cancel request.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Instrument identifier. Required when cancelling all orders for a security.

Field.Name: MarketSegmentID
Field.Description: Market segment for the mass cancel.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the mass cancel was initiated.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the execution report.

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Reason for an execution report restatement.

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: The point in the matching process at which this trade was matched.

Field.Name: AggressorIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether the order was the aggressor in the trade.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the cancel or cancel/replace request.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order that cannot be canceled or replaced.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Status of order after the Cancel Reject.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Valid values: 1 = Order Cancel Request, 2 = Order Cancel/Replace Request.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for cancel rejection.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID provided on the Mass Cancel Request.

Field.Name: MassActionReportID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the mass action report.

Field.Name: MassCancelResponse
Field.Description: Response to the mass cancel request.

Field.Name: MassCancelRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason the mass cancel was rejected.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of the mass cancel report.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType of the FIX message being rejected.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: RefID of the message being rejected.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for Business rejection.

Field.Name: BidID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the bid side of the quote.

Field.Name: OfferID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the offer side of the quote.

Field.Name: QuoteMsgID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the quote cancel message.

Field.Name: QuoteMsgID
Field.Description: Identifier of the quote or quote cancel message being reported.

Field.Name: BidID
Field.Description: Bid identifier of the quote being reported.

Field.Name: OfferID
Field.Description: Offer identifier of the quote being reported.

Field.Name: QuoteCancelType
Field.Description: Type of quote cancel being reported.

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the trade capture report.

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Type of transaction represented by this report.

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: TradeReportID of the corresponding Trade Capture Report.

Field.Name: TradeReportRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason the trade capture report was rejected.

Field.Name: EntitlementsRequestID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the entitlements request.

Field.Name: EntitlementsReportID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the entitlements report.

Field.Name: TotNoPartyList
Field.Description: Total number of parties in the report.

Field.Name: LastFragment
Field.Description: Indicates whether this is the last fragment of a fragmented report.

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: Party identifier. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: DisclosureType
Field.Description: Type of disclosure instruction. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: ValueCheckType
Field.Description: Type of value check. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: ValueCheckAction
Field.Description: Action to take for the value check.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Instrument identifier of the quote entry. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the trade. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the firm for this side.

Field.Name: OrderCategory
Field.Description: Category of the order for this side.

Field.Name: ClearingInstruction
Field.Description: Clearing instruction. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: PartyDetailID
Field.Description: Party detail identifier. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: EntitlementIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether the party is entitled. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: EntitlementAttribType
Field.Description: Type of entitlement attribute. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: EntitlementAttribDataType
Field.Description: Data type of the entitlement attribute.

Field.Name: InstrumentScopeOperator
Field.Description: Operator to apply to the instrument scope. Used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityID
Field.Description: Security ID of the instrument scope.

Field.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Source of the instrument scope Security ID.
